Translation Assistant

A Microsoft Word add-in that propagates tracked changes from an English source cell to the corresponding French and German cells.

Download Word add-in manifest

Install in Word

  1. Download the manifest using the button above.
  2. In Word, open Home → Add-ins → More Add-ins.
  3. Open My Add-ins, choose Upload, and select the manifest.
  4. Open Translation Assistant from Word.

After installation, the add-in connects securely to the hosted Translation Assistant service. You only need Word and an internet connection. If the Upload option is unavailable, your organization may have disabled custom add-ins.

Document processing

Only affected source paragraphs and the three corresponding language cells are sent to the configured translation service. The complete document is not uploaded.
